email_subject: Application - Marketing Account Manager at PwC Belgium
email_body:
Dear Hiring Manager,

I am writing to apply for the Marketing Account Manager position at PwC Belgium. With hands-on experience in digital marketing, SEO, and content creation, I am eager to bring my skills to your team.

At Episto, I manage on-page SEO, create keyword-targeted content, and build WordPress sites for clients. I also run my own project, mirook.com, where I apply technical SEO and GEO strategies to improve search visibility. These experiences have honed my project management and communication skills, and I thrive in collaborative environments.

I am fluent in English and Turkish, with Dutch at B1 level, and I am actively improving my Dutch. I am excited about the opportunity to contribute to PwC's marketing initiatives and to grow within your dynamic team.

Thank you for considering my application. I look forward to the possibility of discussing how I can add value to your organization.

Sincerely,
Baver Ok
+32 470 42 48 36
baverok@gmail.com
linkedin.com/in/baverok
cover_letter:
Dear Hiring Manager,

I am excited to apply for the Marketing Account Manager role at PwC Belgium. Your emphasis on end-to-end campaign ownership and stakeholder collaboration resonates with my experience and aspirations.

In my current role as a Junior Digital Marketer at Episto, I manage SEO and content projects for multiple clients, from keyword research to publishing and performance reporting. This involves coordinating with team members, understanding client needs, and delivering measurable results—skills directly applicable to managing marketing initiatives at PwC. Additionally, my personal project, mirook.com, showcases my ability to independently plan and execute a comprehensive digital strategy, including technical SEO, content creation, and social media integration.

I am fluent in English and Turkish, with Dutch at B1 level, and I am committed to further improving my Dutch. My technical background in web design and analytics allows me to communicate effectively with both creative and technical teams. I am a proactive problem-solver who enjoys learning new tools and taking initiative.

I am drawn to PwC's culture of continuous learning and its global network. I am eager to contribute to your marketing campaigns and to grow as a professional within your team. Thank you for considering my application. I look forward to the opportunity to discuss how my skills align with your needs.

Sincerely,
Baver Ok
